What we do

Protective styles, made to fit you

From featherlight knotless braids to crochet curls — every style is installed with a gentle hand and finished with care.

Knotless Box Braids

Featherlight box braids with no knot at the root — gentler on your edges and natural from day one.

Price upon request

Twists & Senegalese

Rope, Senegalese and knotless twists with soft movement and a polished, long-lasting finish.

Price upon request

Cornrows & Feed-Ins

Clean stitch braids and feed-in designs, from simple straight-backs to sculpted, custom patterns.

Price upon request

Locs & Two-Strand Twists

Starter locs, retwists and two-strand twists for every stage of your loc journey.

Price upon request

Box Braids

The classic: neat square parts and individual braids, in any length or thickness you like.

Price upon request
